name: hub-remote
description: Drive a programmable robot hub from the browser over Web Bluetooth.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: node tests/test_proto.js && node tests/test_cards.js && node tests/test_ldraw.js && python3 -I tests/test_hub_program.py
scripts.test:browser: node tests/test_page.js && node tests/test_fold.js && node tests/test_sw.js && node tests/test_landing.js
scripts.vendor:blockly: cp node_modules/blockly/blockly_compressed.js vendor/blockly/ && cp node_modules/blockly/msg/nl.js vendor/blockly/msg-nl.js && cp node_modules/blockly/msg/en.js vendor/blockly/msg-en.js && cp node_modules/blockly/media/* site/blockly-media/ && cp node_modules/blockly/LICENSE licenses/Apache-2.0-Blockly.txt
